features: APPLE PENCIL AND SMART FOLIO — Apple Pencil Pro transforms iPad mini into an immersive drawing canvas and the world’s best note‐taking device. Apple Pencil (USB-C) is also compatible with iPad mini. To protect your iPad mini and easily prop it up, you can use the slim Smart Folio covers, available in four colours.

ADVANCED CAMERAS — iPad mini features a 12MP Ultra Wide front camera that supports Centre Stage for videoconferencing and selfies. The 12MP Wide back camera with True Tone flash is perfect for document scanning and capturing photos and 4K videos.

CONNECTIVITY — Wi-Fi 6E gives you fast wireless connections.* Work from almost anywhere with quick transfers of photos, documents and large video files. Get faster USB-C speeds with the USB-C connector.
UNLOCK WITH TOUCH ID — Touch ID is built into the top button, so you can use your fingerprint to unlock your iPad and sign in to apps.

WHY IPAD MINI—The full iPad experience in an ultraportable design. Featuring Apple Intelligence. With an 8.5-inch OLED display, ultrafast A20 Pro chip, 12MP front camera with Center Stage, USB-C connectivity, superfast Wi-Fi 7, and compatibility with Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C). Take notes, mark up documents, and edit photos and videos.
DESIGN—Thin, light, and ultraportable design. Water and dust resistance for even more peace of mind. Resists splashes and spills—and whatever else the day throws at it.

8.5-INCH SUPER RETINA XDR DISPLAY—Get dramatic contrast and precise, vivid colors with advanced OLED display technology. Nano-texture display glass is available in 256GB and 512GB configurations for incredible visibility even in bright settings.

PERFORMANCE AND STORAGE—A20 Pro chip. A huge leap in performance. A total AI powerhouse. Featuring a fast 16-core Neural Engine, with a Dual 16-core Neural Engine in the 512GB configuration. All-day battery life and fast-charging keeps iPad mini ready for any size task. Storage starting at 128GB for all your apps, music, movies, and more.

IPADOS—Run pro apps and get more done with the ease and power of iPadOS 27. Multitask on two or more windows at once with an intuitive and flexible windowing system. Featuring new and expanded child safety features, next-level intelligent photo editing, and more.
APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.

APPLE PENCIL AND SMART FOLIO—Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C) enable intuitive and precise control for drawing, note-taking, and creativity. To protect and prop up the iPad mini, use the slim Smart Folio covers. Accessories sold separately.
CONNECTIVITY—Superfast Wi-Fi 7 keeps you connected at home, work, school, or wherever you go with your iPad.
